checklist.notes: Manage-sense run and past-perfect timing recur across completion, construction, reading, speaking, and translation. The item objective indices and lesson references make the intended support inspectable.
Instructions, stimuli, answer data, explanations, and analytic rubrics give a self-study learner usable response and feedback expectations.
The set generally moves from controlled or receptive work toward productive application without an excessive jump for the declared tier.
The tasks are answerable as written; the local wording or evidence limitation recorded below does not invalidate the full set.
Five short, bounded exercises provide useful variety without padding or an unreasonable response burden.
The mix (fill_blank, sentence_construction, reading, speaking, translation) supports the lesson; transcript-only listening is treated as script-supported rather than observed audio performance.
Vietnamese names, practical settings, translation where present, and explicit language/pronunciation focus make the set accessible without stereotyping.

findings.description: A written construction item cannot demonstrate the /n/-to-vowel link required by its scoring guidance.
findings.recommendation: Score written order separately and reserve link realization for speaking or audio evidence.

limitations: Review covers only the immutable exercise set and fresh static machine report; transcript-only tasks were not heard, subjective responses were not learner-tested, and no human or release approval is claimed.
